notes: Optional Niagara overlays from the purchased Fab VFX packs (Docs/FAB-PURCHASED.md). Paths point into locally installed, never-committed pack folders; a path is used only when its package exists, otherwise the procedural presentation stands alone. schools.<school>.<role> with role in cast|projectile|impact|area|aura; school names from CireAbilityShapes::SchoolName (steel fire frost storm shadow life holy poison arcane earth nature spirit blood tide void) plus 'default'. buffs.<effectId | kind.school | kind>. Each entry: {paths:[...first existing wins], scale, tint:[r,g,b]}. Generated/refreshed by Tools/MapFabVFX.py; hand edits are kept.
groundNotes: telegraphs (2026-09-26): Fab ground overlays are curated. groundRadius = XY footprint (cm) of the system spawned at scale 1, measured by Tools/RunSpellGallery.py --fab-ground (CIRE_FAB_GROUND_MEASURE); only listed systems decorate a circle zone, scaled to 92% of its true radius and dimmed with the ground-telegraph slider. groundExcluded = never used on the ground, with the reason.
